market_question: Will the Carolina Hurricanes win the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup?
reasoning: The Hurricanes are a consistent playoff team but have not yet won a Cup in their recent window. Estimating a 37.5% probability for a single team to win a specific future Stanley Cup (2026) is historically unrealistic; even the strongest NHL team typically carries under 15% chance in any given season due to parity, injuries, and randomness. Their true probability is likely around 12%, making the market overpriced on Yes.
evidence_points: NHL parity: even Presidents' Trophy winners rarely exceed 15-20% Cup probability pre-playoffs.
Carolina has not reached a Cup Final since 2006 and lost in the second round in 2024.
Rosters can change significantly over two seasons (2025 offseason, trades, cap issues).
Other contenders (Florida, Edmonton, Colorado, etc.) share the probability mass.
